 WEEK IN PHOTOS: Election Day, arts events and more 
 Emily Laycock, Benjamin Jacobstein, Quinn FitzHenry, Wesley Webb, Zachary Krausman, Hannarose Schiano, Tye Brown, Lily Perella, Evan Frilingos 
 Nov 9, 2026 
 Nov 9, 2026 
 Updated 
 11 hrs ago 
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 WhatsApp 
 LinkedIn 
 SMS 
 Email 
 Print 
 Copy article link 
 Save 
 This week in Athens, Election Day brought voters to the polls and people to watch parties, Julien Baker spoke to students in the University of Georgia Music Business Program before playing at the 40 Watt, the Fall Dodd Market showcased over 100 student artists' work, t he Taylor-Grady House hosted their annual Fall Festival, a Red Bull Chariot Race was held downtown, t he Athens Rock Lobsters defeated the Birmingham Bulls 5-1 and  Shop With A Bulldog held its annual Event Day for over 500 local elementary students. 
 Michael Ross casts his vote at Clarke Central High School on November 3, 2026 in Athens, Georgia. (Photo/Emily Laycock)
 Barbara Sims, a poll worker, poses in front of a ballot scanner at Clarke Central High School on November 3, 2026 in Athens, Georgia. (Photo/Emily Laycock)
 Kayla Griffin votes at Clarke Central High School, checks the voting machines on November 3, 2026 in Athens, Georgia. (Photo/Emily Laycock)
 People walk to and from the Athens-Clarke County Library, the polling place for Precincts 7A and 7B, in Athens, Georgia, on Election Day, Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026. Precinct 7A moved to the library, joining Precinct 7B. (Photo/Benjamin Jacobstein, @ben.jacobstein.photo) 
 Benjamin Jacobstein 
 From left, poll workers Sam Kallepalli, Shirley Berry and Bettye Candis sit at the check-in table as Tommy Glenn, standing at center, looks on at the Bobby Snipes Water Resource Center in Athens, Georgia, on Election Day, Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026. Poll workers check voters in on electronic poll pads before they mark their ballots. (Photo/Benjamin Jacobstein, @ben.jacobstein.photo) 
 Benjamin Jacobstein 
 Ruby Grainy poses outside Clarke Central High School after her parents, Julie and Brandon, voted Tuesday morning, Nov. 3, 2026.
 Quinn FitzHenry 
 Chase Reed (far left) checks election results on his phone while James Gibbs (left middle), Emma Beck (middle right) and Bella Zorzoli update an election result spreadsheet during the 10th Congressional District Republican election night watch party on Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026, at The Venues on Broad in Athens, Georgia. (Photo/Wesley Webb) 
 Wesley Webb 
 Houston Gaines high fives a supporter as he walks towards the podium after winning District 10 in Georgia's House of Representatives at the 10th Congressional District Republican election night watch party on Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026, at The Venues on Broad in Athens, Georgia. Gaines is an Athens native and University of Georgia graduate. (Photo/Wesley Webb) 
 Wesley Webb 
 Attendees celebrate the win of Democratic gubernatorial nominee Keisha Lance Bottoms at the Georgia Election Night Watch Party at Little King’s Shuffle Club celebrate the win of on Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026, in Athens, Georgia. (Photo/Zachary Krausman)
 Zachary Krausman 
 A cardboard cutout of Jon Ossoff attends the Georgia Election Night Watch Party hosted by Athens-Clarke County Democrats at Little King’s Shuffle Club on Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026, in Athens, Georgia. (Photo/Zachary Krausman)
 Zachary Krausman 
 Singer-songwriter Julien Baker smiles during an MBUS Talk at Moore-Rooker Hall in Athens, Georgia, on Thursday, Nov. 5, 2026. Baker, a member of the band boygenius, is playing a three-night residency at 40 Watt Club on Nov. 5-7. (Photo/Benjamin Jacobstein @ben.jacobstein.photo) 
 Benjamin Jacobstein 
 Students sit on the floor and at computer stations as singer-songwriter Julien Baker, right, talks with David Barbe, director of UGA's Music Business Program, foreground, during an MBUS Talk in Room A015 of Moore-Rooker Hall in Athens, Georgia, on Thursday, Nov. 5, 2026. The talk, open only to students in the program, drew a full room ahead of Baker's three-night residency at 40 Watt Club. (Photo/Benjamin Jacobstein @ben.jacobstein.photo) 
 Benjamin Jacobstein 
 A sweatshirt sold during the Fall Dodd Market at the Lamar Dodd School of Art in Athens, Georgia, on Friday, Nov. 6, 2026. The event included other types of merch for sale like stickers, tote bags, t-shirts and more. (Photo/Hannarose Schiano) 
 Hannarose Schiano 
 Scenes from the Fall Dodd Market at the Lamar Dodd School of Art in Athens, Georgia, on Friday, Nov. 6, 2026. The event had over 100 student vendors, live music and food sold by Cafe Racer. (Photo/Hannarose Schiano) 
 Hannarose Schiano 
 Scenes from the Fall Dodd Market at the Lamar Dodd School of Art in Athens, Georgia, on Friday, Nov. 6, 2026. (Photo/Hannarose Schiano)
 Hannarose Schiano 
 Scenes from the annual Fall Festival at the Taylor-Grady House in Athens, Georgia, on Saturday, Nov. 7, 2026. The event featured local vendors, historical demonstrations, family activities and educational programs celebrating traditional crafts, agriculture and foodways. (Photo/Hannarose Schiano) 
 Hannarose Schiano 
 Local Athens children learn about the spinning wool during the annual Fall Festival at the Taylor-Grady House in Athens, Georgia, on Saturday, Nov. 7, 2026. The event featured local vendors, historical demonstrations, family activities and educational programs celebrating traditional crafts, agriculture and foodways. (Photo/Hannarose Schiano) 
 Hannarose Schiano 
 Scenes from the annual Fall Festival at the Taylor-Grady House in Athens, Georgia, on Saturday, Nov. 7, 2026. The event featured local vendors, historical demonstrations, family activities and educational programs celebrating traditional crafts, agriculture and foodways. (Photo/Hannarose Schiano)
 Hannarose Schiano 
 Event attendees crowd College Square for the Red Bull Chariot Race in Athens, Georgia, on Saturday, Nov. 7, 2026. (Photo/Tye Brown; @captured.by.tye) 
 Tye Brown 
 An event competitor interacts with spectators on Clayton Street during the Red Bull Chariot Race in Athens, Georgia, on Saturday, Nov. 7, 2026. (Photo/Tye Brown; @captured.by.tye) 
 Tye Brown 
 Competitors race down Clayton Street during the Red Bull Chariot Race in Athens, Georgia, on Saturday, Nov. 7, 2026. (Photo/Tye Brown; @captured.by.tye) 
 Tye Brown 
 Athens Rock Lobsters forward Nikita Borodaenko (17) fights with Birmingham Bulls defenseman Cole Jungwirth (27) during a hockey game at Akins Ford Arena in Athens, Georgia, on Saturday, Nov. 7, 2026. The Rock Lobsters won 5-1. (Photo/Lily Perella; @PhotographyLKP) 
 Fans watch a hockey game between the Athens Rock Lobsters and the Birmingham Bulls at Akins Ford Arena in Athens, Georgia, on Saturday, Nov. 7, 2026. The Rock Lobsters won 5-1. (Photo/Lily Perella; @PhotographyLKP) 
 Athens Rock Lobsters forward Jesse Lowell (18) scores his second goal of the night during a hockey game against the Birmingham Bulls at Akins Ford Arena in Athens, Georgia, on Saturday, Nov. 7, 2026. The Rock Lobsters won 5-1. (Photo/Lily Perella; @PhotographyLKP) 
 Athens Rock Lobsters forward Jesse Lowell (18) smiles for the camera with captain and defenseman Carter Shinkaruk (14) after a hockey game against the Birmingham Bulls at Akins Ford Arena in Athens, Georgia, on Saturday, Nov. 7, 2026. The Rock Lobsters won 5-1. (Photo/Lily Perella; @PhotographyLKP) 
 Students dance during a talent show at the Shop With A Bulldog Event Day in Athens, Georgia, on Sunday, Nov. 8, 2026. SWAB is a student-run organization at the University of Georgia that annually partners with local elementary schools to bring over 500 elementary students on paid-for a shopping-spree at Walmart and a day of activities at Cedar Shoals High School. (Photo/Evan Frilingos; @frilingos.photos)
 Evan Frilingos 
 A student from Timothy Road Elementary points at items on a shelf in Walmart during the Shop With A Bulldog Event Day in Athens, Georgia, on Sunday, Nov. 8, 2026. Elementary students picked out toys, clothes and more. (Photo/Evan Frilingos; @frilingos.photos)
 Evan Frilingos 
 A student from J.J. Harris Elementary cuts wrapping paper during the Shop With A Bulldog Event Day in Athens, Georgia, on Sunday, Nov. 8, 2026. Wrapping took place between lunch and games in the gym. (Photo/Evan Frilingos; @frilingos.photos)
 Evan Frilingos 
 Students from J.J. Harris Elementary race during the Shop With A Bulldog Event Day in Athens, Georgia, on Sunday, Nov. 8, 2026. (Photo/Evan Frilingos; @frilingos.photos)
